name: DVO Modules and Extensions for Divi
author: Nazmul Hosen

sections.description:
DVO Modules and Extensions for Divi adds 30 modules to the Divi 5 Visual Builder. Build
business pages with FAQ accordions, pricing tables, testimonials, buttons,
image carousels and comparison sliders. The package also includes 10 optional
site tools. Required child items ship with their parent modules and are not
separate entries in the module picker.

Included modules

  1. Advanced Button – Add and style a button.
  2. Dual Buttons – Place two buttons together.
  3. Call To Action – Build a call-to-action section.
  4. Info Card – Arrange content in a card.
  5. Icon List – Create a list with icons.
  6. FAQ Accordion – Display questions and answers.
  7. Pricing Tables – Compare plans in a table layout.
  8. Testimonials – Display customer quotes.
  9. Star Rating – Show a rating element.
  10. Advanced Title – Add a styled heading.
  11. Text Content – Add a text content block.
  12. Multi Heading – Combine heading text in one module.
  13. Breadcrumbs – Show page navigation links.
  14. Business Hours – Display opening hours.
  15. Google Map – Display a configured map.
  16. Profile Card – Present a profile.
  17. Price List – Display items and prices.
  18. Progress Bar – Display a configurable progress indicator.
  19. Number Counter – Display a number counter.
  20. Timeline – Arrange events in a timeline.
  21. Image Accordion – Arrange images in an accordion.
  22. Image Hover – Add an image hover effect.
  23. Image Magnifier – Let visitors inspect an image more closely.
  24. Logo Carousel – Display images or logos in a carousel.
  25. Image Carousel – Display a sequence of images.
  26. Before After Slider – Compare two images with a slider.
  27. Image Reveal – Add an image reveal effect.
  28. Image Tilt – Add an image tilt effect.
  29. Lottie Animation – Display a Lottie animation.
  30. Advanced Tabs – Organize content in tabs.

Optional extensions

  • Back To Top – Add a return-to-top control.
  • Cache Cleaner – Clear supported caches from the site tools.
  • Admin Bar Control – Configure the WordPress admin bar.
  • Extended File Support – Configure additional supported upload types.
  • Divi Preloader – Add a page preloader.
  • Login Customizer – Style the WordPress login screen.
  • Maintenance Mode – Show a maintenance page when enabled.
  • Footer Customizer – Adjust the site footer.
  • Custom Fonts – Manage local fonts and optional Google Fonts downloads.
  • Dark Mode – Add dark mode controls.

All included functionality is free, without a license key, trial period, or
usage quota. Extensions are disabled by default and can be enabled individually.
The package excludes other-edition modules and extensions. Divi 5 is required.

Module styling uses the built-in design controls. This edition does not include
module custom CSS editors or process previously saved module custom CSS. Move
existing custom CSS to WordPress’s Additional CSS editor before switching editions.

Divi 5 is a third-party dependency, sold separately by Elegant Themes at
https://www.elegantthemes.com/gallery/divi/ . This plugin does not include Divi.
This is an independent extension and does not imply endorsement by Elegant Themes.

External services

Google Map: when an administrator configures and publishes this module, visitors’
browsers contact Google to display the map. Requests can include IP address,
browser information, and the configured map location. The feature is optional.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Custom Fonts: local font uploads work without Google. If an administrator explicitly
uses the Google Fonts download feature, the server requests the selected font from
Google Fonts. Google receives the server IP and the requested font details.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Login Customizer: selecting a Google font for the login form causes visitors’
browsers to request that font from Google Fonts, sharing IP and browser details.
Leave the font selection empty to use local fallback fonts.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Lottie animations and images can use URLs selected by the administrator. Remote
URLs contact the selected host; use local Media Library assets to avoid those requests.
No plugin telemetry is added by this edition.
sections.installation:
Requires WordPress 6.0 or newer, PHP 7.4 or newer, and a supported Divi 5
installation. Divi is obtained separately from Elegant Themes.

  1. Back up your website. Test this edition on a staging site first.
  2. Install and activate a supported Divi 5 theme or builder.
  3. Install this plugin through Plugins > Add New, or upload its ZIP there, and activate it.
  4. Open the Divi Visual Builder and search for a DVO module, such as DVO FAQ.
  5. Enable only the site tools you need in the plugin’s Extensions tab.
sections.faq:
Do I need Divi 5?

Yes. The modules require a supported Divi 5 installation. Divi 4 is not
supported by this edition.

Are the included modules and extensions free?

Yes. The 30 modules and 10 optional extensions in this package have no license
key, trial period, or usage quota.

Can this replace the full edition on an existing website?

Both editions share module identifiers. Do not run them together. This edition
uses the dvo-modules-and-extensions-for-divi directory. Pages using modules outside the free catalog need the full edition.
Review existing content before replacing editions. Back up files and the database.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Free extension uninstall routines remove their settings and generated data.
Custom Fonts removes its uploaded font files and font records. Back up before
deleting. Other-edition cloud media credentials and mappings are not deleted.

Where is the source code?

Readable PHP, TypeScript/React, styles, package metadata, and webpack configuration
are included. To rebuild the included JavaScript on a development copy, run
npm ci followed by npm run build with Node.js 18+ and npm 10+.
Production sites do not need Node.js or Composer.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial free edition: 30 modules and 10 opt-in extensions.
  • Dedicated builder bundle and metadata containing only the free catalog.
  • Excludes PDF, cloud offload, social-network SDKs, and paid module implementations.
